InvitationStatus.title: InvitationStatus

InvitationSummaryOut.description:
The counts of the Class's Student Invitations, computed by the api at read time, and the
addresses the mail did not reach, by address. `sent`: handed to the mail provider; `bounced`:
of those, reported bounced; `accepted`: accepted (Story 4.5); `expired`: neither accepted nor
voided, and past their last valid day now. Each counts Invitations, not addresses.
InvitationSummaryOut.title: InvitationSummaryOut

InvitationTokenIn.description: The token of an Invitation link, from the fragment of `/invitasjon#<token>` (Story 3.8).
InvitationTokenIn.title: InvitationTokenIn

RegistrationOut.description:
One address on the Roster with its status. `id` names the Roster entry for a reminder to
it alone; `remindable` is whether a reminder would go to it (not registered, not a hard
bounce).
RegistrationOut.title: RegistrationOut

RegistrationStatus.description:
Where a Roster address stands, read at request time; the first that applies wins.
`registered` / `registered_manually`: a Student in the Class (stored). `renewal_requested`:
the Student asked for a new Invitation from a link that no longer works. `bounced`: the mail
of its newest Invitation did not arrive (with `bounce_class`). `invited`: its newest
Invitation still works (with `last_valid_day`). `unregistered`: its newest Invitation expired
unaccepted (or it has none).
RegistrationStatus.title: RegistrationStatus

RegistrationsOut.description:
«Status etter utsending»: the totals, how many addresses have not registered («Send
påminnelse til N»), and every address by address.
RegistrationsOut.title: RegistrationsOut

ReminderIn.description:

ReminderIn.title: ReminderIn

ReminderOut.description:

ReminderOut.title: ReminderOut

ResetEmailOut.description: The address a reset link belongs to, so «Logg inn» can be prefilled.

get.description: The open requests for lecturer access, newest first (Story 3.13, FR-1).

post.description:
Dismiss an open request for lecturer access, with one audit row (Story 3.13, FR-3). A
request that is not open, or unknown, is `not_found`.

get.description:
Audit events newest first, with actor and target names read now (FR-3, AD-14). Filter by
`actor` (a User id, or `system` for the rows with no actor), `action`, and the inclusive
Europe/Oslo days `since` and `until`.

Everyone who appears as actor in the log, for the filter: the system first (`id` null),
then Users by name.
The Institutions with name and creation date, newest first (FR-3).

post.description:
Create an Institution (FR-3). Refused with `institution_name_taken` when another has the
name, compared case-insensitively; a bad name answers `fields.name`.

patch.description:
Give an Institution a new name (FR-3). Refused as creating is; an unknown id is
`not_found`.

get.description:
The newest Invitation to each address and role, newest first, with its status and whether
the recipient asked for a new one (FR-1, FR-3).

post.description:
Invite an address to the Lecturer or Admin role (FR-1). Sending again to the same address
and role voids the earlier link. With `access_request_id` of an open request for lecturer
access, the request is closed as invited (Story 3.13). The address of a deactivated User is
refused with 409 `account_deactivated` (Story 3.10).

Send an open or expired Invitation again with a new link and expiry; the old link stops
working (FR-3).

get.description:
Users with their account roles and status, by name, searched by part of the e-mail or
the name (FR-2, FR-3). The search text is never logged (AD-14).

post.description:
Deactivate a User: they cannot log in, their sessions end at once, and none of their data
is deleted (FR-3). Refused with `last_admin` for oneself or the last active Admin.
Reactivate a User: they log in again with the same password and roles (FR-3).
Give a User the Lecturer or Admin role; it holds from their next request (FR-2).

delete.description:
Take the Lecturer or Admin role from a User; it ends at their next request (FR-2). Refused
with `last_admin` or `role_revoke_blocked` (`fields.classes`).

post.description:
Create the account an Invitation offers and log in (FR-1, FR-4): with its role, or, for a
Student Invitation, as a registered Student of its Class (Story 4.5, FR-8).

Add an Invitation's role, or its Class (Story 4.5), to the account its address already
has, and log in.
Whether an Invitation link still works, and what «Du er invitert» shows for it.

Ask for a new Invitation from a link that no longer works. The answer is the same `202`
for any link (UX-DR61).

Mail a reset link if the address has an active account. The answer is the same `202`
whether or not it has one (UX-DR61).
Whether a reset link still works, and the address it belongs to.
Set a new password through a reset link; the link then stops working.

get.description: The Classes the User is staff of, by name: «Klassene dine» on the Lærerhjem.

post.description:
Create a Class with the User as its owner (FR-6). A refused field answers 422
`invalid_request` with every refused field in `fields`, and nothing is stored.

get.description:
The Classes the User is a Student in, by name (Story 4.5): Hjem names them. Empty for a
User on no Roster.

One Class the User is a Student in. Another Class, one whose Roster no longer holds the
User's address, one that does not exist and an id that is not one all answer the same 403
`forbidden` (FR-5, FR-7).
The Institutions a new Class may belong to, by name.

One Class. A Class the User is not staff of, one that does not exist and an id that is not
one all answer the same 403 `forbidden` (FR-5).

What became of the Class's Student Invitations (Story 4.6, FR-8): how many were sent,
bounced, accepted and expired, computed now, and the Roster addresses whose newest Invitation
bounced, with the bounce's class. A Class the User may not manage, one that does not exist
and an id that is not one all answer the same 403 `forbidden`.

post.description:
«Send N Invitasjoner» (Story 4.4): write the staged upload's valid addresses to the Roster
and send each new address a Student Invitation valid through the `valid_days`-th day after
today (Europe/Oslo), in one transaction; the mails leave from `worker-batch`. 404
`not_found` when `upload_id` is not the Class's staging (sent already, replaced or expired);
422 `nothing_to_send` when no staged row is valid; 422 `invalid_request` with
`fields.valid_days` for a validity outside 1–60 days. Nothing changes on a refusal.

get.description:
«Status etter utsending» (Story 4.7, FR-9): every Roster address with its status, read now
(registered, registered manually, asked for a new Invitation, bounced with its class, invited
with its last valid day, unregistered), the totals and how many have not registered. A Class
the User may not manage, one that does not exist and an id that is not one all answer the
same 403 `forbidden`.

post.description:
«Send påminnelse» (Story 4.7, FR-9, NFR-10): a new Invitation valid through the
`valid_days`-th day after today (Europe/Oslo) to every address that has not registered, or
with `roster_entry_id` to that one alone; their old links stop working. Addresses whose last
mail bounced hard are left out and named in `left_out`. 422 `nothing_to_send` when nothing
would be sent or left out (all registered, or the entry is registered or not on the Roster);
422 `invalid_request` with `fields.valid_days` for a validity outside 1–60 days.

«Lim inn adresser i stedet» (Story 4.3): split the text on line breaks, commas, semicolons
and whitespace and stage the pieces as one-column rows, replacing any earlier staged upload;
`Navn <adresse>` is read as the address. Text over the size limit or with more addresses than
the row limit answers 422 `roster_paste_too_long` and stages nothing.

delete.description: «Bytt fil»: delete the Class's staged upload. 204 whether or not there was one.

get.description:
The Class's staged upload, evaluated against its chosen column; `upload` is null when
there is none or it has expired.

post.description:
Read a Roster file (.xlsx or .csv) in memory and stage its rows for the Class, replacing
any earlier staged upload. A file that cannot be used answers 422 `roster_unreadable` and
stages nothing (the earlier staged upload stays).

put.description:
Choose the e-mail column; the staged rows are evaluated against it at once, from the staged
cells. 404 `not_found` when nothing is staged (or it expired); 422 `invalid_request` with
`fields.column = column_unknown` for a column the file does not have.
